sources.entry: HandySwitch - Lightweight menu bar toggles for dark mode, prevent sleep, and scroll direction. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/x0c/HandySwitch) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: HandySwitch is a lightweight, open-source macOS menu bar app for toggling Dark Mode, Prevent Sleep, Clean Mode, and mouse scroll options without opening System Settings.
summary.what_it_does: HandySwitch puts a set of switches under the macOS menu bar icon. Left-clicking the icon opens a panel with five toggles: Clean Mode, Dark Mode, Prevent Sleep (with preset durations), Reverse Mouse Scroll, and Smooth Mouse Scroll. Clean Mode shows full-screen black covers that block input so you can wipe the screen or keyboard. Dark Mode follows the system appearance setting and is explicitly not Night Shift. Right-clicking the icon offers Open Main Window, Launch at Login, Check for Updates, and Quit. The app states that it has no account, no telemetry, and no Dock icon, and that all data stays on the Mac. The README says it is not intended to be a feature-heavy alternative such as OnlySwitch or Mos, and it does not offer per-app scroll profiles.
use_cases: toggle dark mode from the menu bar
keep the Mac awake during presentations or downloads
clean the screen and keyboard without triggering input
reverse mouse scroll direction on macOS
quick system toggles without opening System Settings
how_to_run: xcodebuild -project HandySwitch.xcodeproj -scheme HandySwitch -configuration Release -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build
stack: macOS Accessibility and Automation (System Events) APIs
notable: Five focused toggles in a single menu bar panel, with no feature marketplace
Clean Mode blocks input with full-screen covers and exits by holding Esc for about three seconds
Signed and notarized DMG distribution plus Homebrew cask install
Runs without a Dock icon and uses a menu bar template icon
No account and no telemetry; fully local
caveats: Requires macOS 26 or later; not available for Windows or Linux
Clean Mode and scroll toggles need Accessibility permission, and Dark Mode needs Automation (System Events) permission
Not on the Mac App Store and not sandboxed, per the README's out-of-scope list
